reasoning: By the pigeonhole principle, assigning 21 distinct pigeons to 20 holes with at most 1 per hole is impossible (requires 21 unique holes)
cot_trace:
The problem is: Place 21 pigeons into 20 holes such that each hole contains at most one pigeon. Each pigeon must be assigned to exactly one hole (numbered 0 to 19).
I see the problem: placing 21 pigeons into 20 holes with at most one pigeon per hole. Each pigeon must go into exactly one hole. But with 21 pigeons and only 20 holes, and no hole can have more than one, it's clearly impossible by the pigeonhole principle.
